"Red" = share of each map's drawn area won by Trump (Alaska and Hawaii as drawn). Lower 48 in Albers equal-area; population cartogram after Dougenik et al. (1985). Alaska reports by house district, so it is one unit in the county map. Electoral tiles grow from each state's place on the population map; Maine and Nebraska split by district. Dots: one per 5,000 votes for each candidate, placed at random inside its county; third-party votes left out. · #30DayMapChallenge
